notes.title: HELSKATE IS OUT OF EARLY ACCESS - EXPERIENCE THE FULL STORY NOW
notes.content:
Hey all! 

Today marks a huge milestone for us. After nearly a year of feature updates and improvements in Early Access, Helskate is now available on Steam!

Check out the launch trailer here:
[previewyoutube=JtHuJrzv-ow;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]What is Helskate? (For those new to the game)
[/b]
In Helskate, grind, perform tricks, and chain combos to power up your attacks and slay the monsters of Vertheim. Combine unique weapons and gear to suit your playstyle as you fight, die, and upgrade your abilities to come back to this labyrinth over and over again!

[list]
[*] Skate your way through Vertheim - Traverse Vertheim as you grind, wall ride and manual your way through this hellscape with classic arcade-style skating
[*] Fight, Die, Upgrade, Repeat -  Combine different weapons, gear and tapes to create powerful and unique builds for each run. Get inked up with sick tattoos to permanently upgrade your abilities for a much needed edge over your foes.
[*] Skateboarding Combat - Chain huge combos, do ollies, kickflips, and other awesome tricks to power up your attacks and gain unique abilities and buffs to slay the monsters that await you in this fast-paced skateboarding action roguelite!
[*] Take on the Gods of Skating - Use everything in your arsenal to battle against the Gods of Skating. Take on the God of Vert Ramps’ score challenge and grind your way up the Ancient God of Skating to strike at his weak points.
[/list]

[b]What new content has been since Early Access?[/b]

[list]
[*] Complete main quest story including playable Memory Tapes
[*] The world of Grindgard (an enitrely new series of tiles after you exit Verthiem)
[*] New World 2 enemies
[*] The Beach!
[*] A new boss fight with a skating twist
[*] The reveal of [REDACTED] in the Vault of Wishes
[*] Lots of small bug fixes based on Discord feedback
[/list]

For any players who joined us during Early Access, your save files should work BUT to experience all the new features we strongly recommend creating a new save file.

This content update is BEEFY and as a small team we’ve done our best to iron out all creases but if anything slips through the net, please let us know over in our [url=https://discord.gg/Mbchpk94Hk]Discord channel [/url]

We will be keeping an eye out in there for any major issues and do our best to jump on them as quickly as we can.

notes.title: "Score Attack" Update
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Vy6MJlgHIhA;full][/previewyoutube]

Hey all! We’ve reworked the core loop of the game completely. The focus is now on points. Skating/combos, killing enemies, doing goals: everything now feeds into score. And score is now the way to progress. We like it a lot. To us, it feels much closer to what the game wants to be. 

Don't forget, the game is in Early Access and could benefit from your feedback! Don’t hesitate to join our [url=https://discord.gg/SAWpahdj]Discord [/url]and let us know what you think. We’re particularly interested in thoughts on / ideas for getting the tuning of the score requirements right for both new and experienced players. 

Also: special thanks to [url=https://www.youtube.com/@yungtown]Yungtown [/url]for the collab on this trailer, we absolutely loved working on it.

Thanks again for playing, 

<3 The Phantom Coast Team

notes.title: "Feel and Flow" Update
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=iE3jzquMSWE;full][/previewyoutube]

Hey all!

A deep and heartfelt thank you once again to everyone playing Helskate! The amount and detail of feedback has been fantastic. This update is all about Feel & Flow and the connection between skating and combat. First, the major combat rework is now live. We’ve retuned the weapons and increased knockback and impact forces to the enemies. The result should allow you to fight enemies without breaking the flow of skating. Put another way, [b]enemies are now a tool for scoring a big combo.[/b] 

Second, we’ve added a feature that helps bridge skating and combat: the Combo Shield. When you hit enemies or smash objects in the environment, a meter builds up.  As long as the combo shield meter is active, it will [b]prevent your combo from breaking[/b]. We’re still working on the exact tuning, but this should help new players ease into scoring big combos and provide another reason to incorporate combat into your combos and vice versa. 

Finally, we’ve added two of your most requested features: the [b]Classic Skating Camera[/b] and [b]Free Skate Mode[/b]. Let us know what you think!

Thanks again! <3

-The Phantom Coast Team

[h3]CHANGELOG[/h3]

[h3][b]Combat feel improvements[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Carry force (ground) - enemies inherit player velocity when hit to improve flow and feel
[*] Juggle force (air) - player will reorient to hit nearby enemies in the air and stay in the air for a bit after a hit
[*] Knock-back’d Enemies now take damage (and bounce!) when hitting walls and each other
[*] Added attack interrupts for most enemies
[*] Increased enemy health to balance against new movement and damage options
[*] Improved speed and feel of magnetting to enemies
[*] Improved hit detection
[*] Improved usability of the “Combo Shield”
[*] Increased combat camera FOV
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224898/7d7d2318a7080c8c36847ac0f44cea09d0e7a10a.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] Added Free Skate mode
[*] Added “Classic” camera mode
[*] Improved settings menu visuals	
[*] Combo break clarity (Player flashes red and plays an animation)
[*] Changed competition score calculations so that it does not get out of hand
[*] Added option for character relative controls
[*] Added new vault
[*] Changed menu exit button assignment to Circle (Playstation) / B (XBox)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224898/0d9affb01b30c8ff1d36a347b97201a4448c5e8e.gif[/img]

notes.title: A message from the team
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224898/938ed272ba7754f75a5218efae61dc02178f55d4.png[/img]

[b]Thank you for supporting Helskate in Early Access! <3 <3 <3 [/b]
It’s a week since launch and it’s been motivating and heart-warming to see so many players vibing with what we made. We know there are a lot of things to improve and we appreciate you supporting us while we work hard on fixes and improvements ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1295630/view/4184476658850304983]roadmap here[/url]). Speaking of which…

[b]Cutscenes & Levels[/b]
First, we’ve implemented the cutscenes that were missing from the initial build and removed the temporary text. There’s a lot of story, systems, and mechanics that didn’t quite make the launch build and we’re keen to share that with you all soon. 

[b]On Unfinished Content[/b]
Why did we ship with unfinished content? Due to many factors, we set a launch date and pushed hard to hit it. This is not ideal and as a result some things didn’t get completed. However, we figured it would be better to have temporary content there rather than simply hide it. 

Helskate is a true Early Access game. We want to make big changes and to iterate fast, especially on the levels and mechanics. It’s MUCH easier to modify and improve levels that have rough or incomplete art than it is to rework levels with finished art. But we’ve heard you - seeing dev textures was off putting for players. In the short term, we’re improving the rough first pass art for the level process. And, of course, final art is being worked on with more to come soon. 

[b]Beta Branch Live![/b]
With all of this in mind, the Beta branch is now live. We will be updating this branch often with the latest fixes and features.  Go here and do this to switch to the Beta branch:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224898/d88b5a386ddd8d4e11f4a746b604c5a6ad333a38.png[/img]

We’ll push updates to the main game when they’re stable and tested. 


[b]A Small Team[/b]
One thing which we haven’t shared clearly is the size of the team. It’s quite small. We work with lots of amazing freelancers but there are relatively few full time developers. So, thanks so much for your patience as we work hard to complete features and implement your feedback. As always, we read through all your reviews and community posts and the Helskate discord is a great place to get in touch. 

Thanks again!


<3 The Phantom Coast Team

Keep playing the demo! 🙂 We have a little competition to announce this week, so it’ll be rewarding in more ways than one… Thank you so much and keep the feedback coming! Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/TjwtSvvP2w

And remember: when you’re going through hell… KEEP SKATING!

[i]Phantom Coast[/i]

notes.title: Fight to skate... and skate to fight!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Z2ecFWChyyU;full][previewyoutube=Z2ecFWChyyU;leftthumb]<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/Z2ecFWChyyU" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>[/previewyoutube]
[/previewyoutube]

Helskate is first and foremost a skating game. There’s also story, player progression, and combat: all of this is added to give new context to classic skating gameplay. The focus is still on doing tricks, finding cool lines, and landing big combos, as we truly love this kind of freeform, find-the-line improvisational skating gameplay. In fact, we love it so much, we want more people to experience it and enjoy it! This is why we’re trying something new, inspired by the joy of skating… but unrestricted by the confines of the real world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224898/6a36bed6a397e5fb70e5442eca9738693e301bd1.png[/img]

[h2]Skating is Everything[/h2]
Combat and skating are fully integrated. Our goal is to make combat fun, satisfying and challenging, but also to make enemy encounters part of the lines and combos. There are long, snake-like enemies to grind across. There are enemies that can be used as ramps. There are enemy projectiles that you can skate on. And hitting them will fluidly continue your skating combo. In other words: enemy encounters donot take away from the skating; they add to it. It’s all part of the same system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224898/1c3721301f80f78c794e31aae78222b08008cab4.gif[/img]

[h2]Have It Your Way[/h2]
You start the game with a familiar set of basic tricks: kickflips, grinds, manuals, grabs, et cetera. Each run into the Helskate you gain Trick Tapes, Gear, and Stat Points, all leading to different builds with different playstyles. Skateboarding tricks power up your attacks, so if you take stat points that give you extra high ollies and reduced flip trick time, you’ll be able to spam missile flips. Or you might create a grind-based build with extra grind damage so you can charge up lightning as you grind through the middle of a bunch of enemies.

Or you might just go all in on raw, unadulterated damage so you can do a massive grab trick to buff your next hit to 1000% damage, and kill enemies with a single, powerful hammer strike.

It’s all up to you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224898/a281e77c3709a1374dd9f5352a170ce572f6d4b9.png[/img]

[h2]Skate and Die[/h2]
In summary: it’s been our goal to make Helskate a classic arcade skating game blended with unique elements. 

Being good at skating will make you better at combat.
Being good at combat opens up more ways to skate. 

Basically: if you’re into skating, Vertheim will be your playground.

Embrace the pain,

[i]Phantom Coast[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224898/cdfa5c8846df2ad2e4ca22f2d0da1bb552a8e1e0.gif[/img]
